messages.text: EASY PAISA LUCKY DRAW 🎉 Aap ka number winner nikla hai 500,000 rupay ka! Reference EP-WIN-2026.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Maine to kabhi draw mein participate hi nahi kiya.

messages.text: Automatic entry hoti hai sab customers ki. Claim karne ke liye 4,999 processing fee chahiye sirf.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Fee JazzCash par bhejein is merchant code par, prize same day release ho jata hai.

messages.text: Prize ke liye fee? Ye to scam lagta hai.

messages.text: Madam ye govt tax hai sirf naam ka. Aaj raat 12 baje tak claim na hui to prize next draw mein chala jaye ga.
